newsitem.title: USA: NYSE says Alliance declines comment.
newsitem.headline: NYSE says Alliance declines comment.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said on Thursday that Alliance Entertainment Corp has declined to comment on its stock's recent unusual market activity.
The exchange said it had requested that the company issue a public statement indicating whether there were any corporate developments which might explain the market activity.
Alliance responded that its policy is not to comment on market activity, the exchange said.
Shares of Alliance traded at 5/8, down 1/8 on the day in late afternoon, on volume of 635,800 shares.
